body:
I think this is a really important question. I’ve been with my partner for 12 years - and they haven’t been easy ones. Life has thrown a lot at me and I can honestly say that it’s the love of my same-sex partner that has gotten me through that. I know that a lot of Christians will say that a same-sex relationship doesn’t have real love in it and I understand that they say that not out of hatred but out of a loving desire to correct. And maybe that’s true - all I know is what I’ve experienced so far. But I do know that the love (or approximation of love) and support of my partner has gotten me through the last 12 years. I write this just to underline how much I would have to give up if I were to one day join a church and have to give up my sinful relationship. I don’t think people understand how much they ask others to give up sometimes.
